statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is closed for the weekend; no live one-way price path is observable.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. Weekend geopolitical risk is reflected primarily in Stress until live price discovery resumes.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while geopolitical Stress remains extreme
body: NQ is closed, so weekend sanctions, Hormuz disruption and Russia-Ukraine escalation cannot be treated as observed Nasdaq trend structure. Conditional risk rises narrowly into the Sunday Globex reopening, where live gap behavior and retracement quality become the key evidence.
